_note: Needs (a) cluster monitoring WITH user-workload monitoring enabled, and (b) a hello-dcs image that serves /metrics — the endpoint was added on 2026-09-11, so an older image makes verify-metrics-endpoint fail with the greeting instead of exposition format. Measured beforehand: the Thanos TENANCY port (9092, namespace param) authorizes on `get pods` in the namespace asked about, so a session needs no platform grant for its own metrics and is refused for anyone else's. The public thanos-querier route is the cluster-wide port and would need one; it is deliberately not used. ServiceMonitor creation needs the RBAC granted in session.objects — the Educates session role has no monitoring.coreos.com rules.

steps.run: envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc apply -f service.yaml && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=240s
url="http://hello-dcs.$(oc project -q).svc:8080"; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -o /dev/null "$url"; done; echo sent 60; curl -s "$url/metrics" | grep hello_dcs_requests_total
oc get servicemonitor hello-dcs -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.matchLabels}{"\n"}'; oc get svc -l app=hello-dcs

TOKEN=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token); curl -sk -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --get "$THANOS_URL/api/v1/query" --data-urlencode "namespace=$(oc project -q)" --data-urlencode 'query=hello_dcs_up' | head -c 300; echo

TOKEN=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token); curl -sk -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --get "$THANOS_URL/api/v1/query" --data-urlencode "namespace=$(oc project -q)" --data-urlencode 'query=sum by (pod) (rate(hello_dcs_requests_total[5m]))' | head -c 300; echo
